overview: Nigel Havers is the suave and deadly Ralph Ernest Gorse, a.k.a. The Charmer - minor public schoolboy, social climber, seducer of women and eternal seeker after the main chance; his stalking grounds are the roadhouses, boarding rooms and grand seaside hotels of the 1930's, the haunts of vulnerable widows and ambitious swindlers. Gorse is no English hero in the traditional sense of the word. He is a psychopath with the plausible charm of every mother's son, a Lothario whose conquests are merely a means to obtaining what he really craves - money and power.
title: The Charmer

overview: Comedy wars, celebrity guests, stand-up comedy from young dads and those over 30, guitar and accordion battles, hits from an optimistic mom, the anti-intellectual show "Lopata", unexpected bloggers – all this and more in "The Weekend Show".
title: Шоу выходного дня

overview: Building Betty & Joan's follows David Ian, Kate Dale and Jeremy Topp as they move their Queer Comedy Club from a venue in North London to a permanent, purpose-built home in Elephant and Castle.
title: Building Betty & Joan's

overview: Ema, a 60-year-old doctor, can see and hear the dead. She calls them "presences" and has lived her entire life avoiding letting this gift connect her with the suffering of others. But when her niece Julie — a disturbed young woman who can also communicate with the dead, but in a much more intense and sexual manner — arrives at her house, Ema is forced to get involved. What begins as a family reunion turns into a disturbing chain of events that alters the balance between the world of the living and the dead, infecting an entire neighborhood with voices from beyond. As the borders between life, death, and desire blur, Ema will have to confront her past, her daughter, and the ghosts she never let go.
title: Mis muertos tristes

overview: ORF's daily society magazine: Seitenblicke, Seitenblicke Weekend and Seitenblicke Spezial.
title: Seitenblicke

overview: Five junior doctors face life and death decisions daily at New Zealand's biggest and busiest hospital, juggling the demanding nature of long shifts, relationships, exhaustion and ambition.
title: Diary of a Junior Doctor

overview: After serving 14 years for a crime from his youth, Ashu returns to reconnect with his brother Max. As they struggle to rebuild trust, Ashu's dark past and dangerous connections resurface, threatening Max's life and business. A gripping story of family, redemption, and the shadows that never truly fade.
title: Kankhajura

overview: Teacher Sun and Nuea, a couple with an age gap, have been living together peacefully—until a major problem arises: Sun starts experiencing erectile dysfunction and can no longer be physically intimate with Nuea. As tension builds in their relationship, Sun turns to "Third," the campus shaman, for help. He receives a mysterious bar of magical soap along with a strict warning: "Never use it with anyone else." But of course, chaos strikes— Nuea ends up joining Sun in a bubble bath filled with that very soap, and in a clumsy moment, their heads knock together... Boom. They switch bodies! Suddenly, Teacher Sun finds himself in the body of a university student, while Nuea wakes up as a respected adult educator. Their lives are turned upside down as they try to navigate each other's worlds, all while having no idea when—or if—they'll ever return to their original bodies.
title: Suntiny

overview: Drama series about upper-crust DI Thomas Lynley and working class DS Barbara Havers, based on the novels of Elizabeth George.
title: The Inspector Lynley Mysteries

overview: After Suowei's girlfriend dumps him, he decides to get revenge by seducing her new boyfriend, Chi Cheng! It started as a game, but falling in love was never part of the plan.
title: Revenged Love

overview: André Hazes was followed by cameras for two years, during perhaps the most difficult period of his life. He is at a crossroads where he struggles with fears and demons. André enters into battle, especially with himself, and that involves some rigorous decisions. We see an extremely vulnerable and honest André. All masks must come off.
title: André Hazes: The Next Chapter

overview: André Hazes was followed by cameras for two years, during perhaps the most difficult period of his life. He is at a crossroads where he struggles with fears and demons. André enters into battle, especially with himself, and that involves some rigorous decisions. We see an extremely vulnerable and honest André. All masks must come off.
title: André Hazes: Crossroads

overview: When Apo Wathinwanit, the heir to the Wathin Group hotel chain, meets a troublemaker, Chonlada, the new receptionist who comes to cause chaos and change the life of a talented female executive who is always focused on work. A relationship full of tricks, between a game of hate and love, which will reach the finish line first?
title: 4 Elements: The Water

overview: Bill Cullen hosted a Weekly First Run Syndication game show from New York City, with Bob Clayton announcing.
title: The $25,000 Pyramid

overview: Hosted by legendary comedian and television personality Howie Mandel, The Price Is Right Tonight is a new Canadian series that brings the iconic game show's joyful wins and classic format to a primetime audience.
title: The Price is Right Tonight

overview: Müge Anlı ile Tatlı Sert (Sweet Hard with Müge Anlı) is a reality and criminal Turkish television program that airs every weekday on atv, hosted by Müge Anlı.
title: Müge Anlı ile Tatlı Sert

overview: Divorces, weddings, children, hobbies, vacations and cars, movie roles and concerts, pets and much more from the lives of glamorous and outrageous stars of Russian and foreign cinema and show business - the rich and famous. Together with the correspondents, you will visit all the important parties, fly to the stars' tours and even visit them.
title: Богатые и знаменитые

overview: At Home with the Braithwaites follows a suburban family from Leeds, whose life is turned upside down when the mother of the family wins 38 million pounds on the lottery.
title: At Home with the Braithwaites

overview: Each of the four episodes of the project is dedicated to a specific topic: career and finance; love, family and friendship; health and leisure; planet. The program features active astrologers, tarot readers and numerologists who will present forecasts and recommendations for the next year for each sign of the Zodiac in the most important areas of our lives.
title: Предсказания

overview: What should a young married couple do when the wife is on maternity leave and the husband has just lost his job? Of course, look for new opportunities! For example, go on a trip across Russia in a small car and film a show about it.
title: Неоплачиваемый отпуск

overview: Culinary masterpieces from Valdis Pelsh, funny interviews and original attempts to solve everyday problems.
title: Одни дома

overview: The self-produced series will tell viewers about the history of domestication of the most important species for humans. Goats and sheep, cows and horses, chickens and ducks, dogs and cats – now we cannot imagine our lives without these animals, habitually calling them domestic. But it was not always so! Leading experts – biologists, archaeologists, Assyriologists – will tell about the influence of domestication not only on people's lives, but also on world culture and mythology.
title: Животные, изменившие мир
Ren Jia Cai Bu Shi Huai Nv Ren

overview: Medical students experience their first practical training in a real hospital, where they have to deal with all the vicissitudes of their profession.
title: Я лечу

overview: Series exploring plans to restore a derelict grocer's shop in Masham, to create an elegant cafe and historic bakery, in a bid to revitalise the town.
title: Our Yorkshire Shop: A Victorian Restoration

overview: When a strange murder takes place in the sleepy market town of Bakerbury. The local police are baffled by a crossword puzzle left on the body. With their case going nowhere, they turn reluctantly to Cora Felton, a recent arrival in Bakerbury; whose fame as the eponymous Puzzle Lady suggests she can help DCI Hooper and the Bakerbury police solve its first murder case. But the eccentric Cora isn't who she claims to be, and as she throws herself into a murder case that has the town's residents baffled, she starts to gather allies and enemies in equal measure.
title: Murder Most Puzzling

overview: Orcas are the rulers of the seas. These majestic marine mammals have captured people's hearts through their intelligence and complex family structures. But ever since killer whales started attacking boats off Gibraltar, many people have wondered: Are they threatening us, or are they just trying to play? Singer and orca enthusiast Sarah Connor narrates, giving the orcas' stories special depth. The two-part documentary shows the specialized hunting strategies and highlights the social intelligence and precise cooperation of the animals. Older family members give the offspring "school lessons" in body control. But the emotional side of the whales also comes into play: how they mourn when a family member dies and how they have fun.
title: Killer Whale Chronicles

overview: Having lost her parents in a traffic accident, the idealistic teacher Afet Güçverir traveled all over Anatolia with her younger brother Kerem. Afet Güçverir, who favors creative education rather than rote memorization, has seen various transfers and expulsions and has never forgotten her former colleague and love Tekin Bey, whom she had to leave because he slapped her brother. Years later, she and her brother arrive at Istanbul Rıdvan Kanat High School, their last exile. This transfer will be a new life for Afet Güçverir and the beginning of a long life education for the students.
title: Hayat Bilgisi

overview: An unexpected inheritance thrusts a pair of scrappy sisters into a world of generational wealth and long-buried crimes.
title: Disinherited

overview: The hero of the film is a successful businessman. And just when Sergey is at the height of his success, his father-in-law suggests that he take another step. But to do this, he has to sacrifice a lot. Sergey refuses the lucrative offer, and his entire well-established life immediately begins to fall apart...
title: Свой человек

overview: The indomitable Fatima roams the cities of Central Asia and Russia, committing one crime after another. She encounters prosecutor Petr Yerozhin, who does not yet know how closely this investigation will intertwine with his own fate. The year is 1986. Young captain Yerozhin, a ladies' man and promising detective, is offered to become an undercover KGB agent. He refuses, ready to work as a loader rather than "snitch" on his comrades. At the same time, in distant Samarkand, Yerozhin's friend, police captain Vakhid Ibragimov, is having trouble getting his family life together. The bizarre interweaving and continuation of these two events serves as the plot of the series. Ibragimov's "daughter", having gone through a long path of shame and humiliation, becomes an indomitable criminal. Vakhid, who has become a big man by this time, is destined to be the first to fall by her hand. Police abuse of power will turn an ordinary slacker Edik Kadkov into a sinister maniac killer. True love will come to Yerozhin at 45, but this will only complicate his investigation. The fast-paced action moves from Central Asia to the Russian hinterland, from regional centers to both Russian capitals, forcing us to admire the positive characters and eagerly await the outcome.
title: Близнецы

overview: «Экстренный вызов» is a screen adaptation of the works by A. Rogov. The film consists of 16 episodes, 4 episodes for each work ("Superfluous Witness", "Doctor Death", "Missing Patient" and "Deadly Diagnosis"). The main character is a doctor at a prestigious private clinic, Vladimir Ladygin. One day, he provides assistance to a victim of a gunshot wound. He extracts a strange plastic capsule from the wounded man's throat, which he decides to keep for now. Two large companies are hunting for the information contained in this capsule. The doctor, who turns out to be an unnecessary witness, is involuntarily drawn into this showdown. Ladygin has no choice but to start his own investigation, which may cost him his life. The detective story is filmed very excitingly and will appeal to fans of the genre.
title: Экстренный вызов

overview: In the show "Skhodka" popular bloggers and artists meet their fans face to face. Some ask candid questions, and others answer, even if the questions are mega unpleasant.
title: Сходка

overview: Leaders united people with a powerful idea, people blindly believed in this idea, not even suspecting that they had become members of a sect - pseudo-religious or openly sadistic. They completely obeyed the leaders and were subjected to psychological violence. In a series of documentaries, victims of deception will tell how they ended up in sects.
title: Секты

overview: The series mixes a Bonnie and Clyde-style adventure of bent cops, kidnapping, underworld fixers, libido-enhancing horse medication bootleggers, and the dilemmas of unconventional heroes and villains with an 8th Century tall tale of monks, Vikings, buried treasure, and a priceless holy book.
title: Tall Tales & Murder
Tai Zi Fei De Xiu Fu Da Ye

overview: Thomas Leclerc, a sympathetic and somewhat nerd theologian, finds himself in the face of a complex police investigation. Detective Savard, a friend, asks for his expertise to decode religious symbols left on the bodies of victims of sordid murders. Thomas's intuitive intelligence, as well as his great knowledge, makes it possible to establish a link between crimes and a mysterious group of devotees with a troubled past.
title: Le dernier des monstres

overview: This is the untold story of Nora Dalmasso's shocking murder, with exclusive interviews from her husband Marcelo, son Facundo and daughter Valentina.
title: Las mil muertes de Nora Dalmasso

overview: Fırat was a Turkish television drama series that aired on Star TV between 1997 and 1998. The lead roles were played by İbrahim Tatlıses, Aydemir Akbaş, Atilla Pakdemir and Gülben Ergen. The series ended with its 34th episode.
title: Fırat

overview: The series main focus is a treasure map that was inherited by Su Zhenyuan from his late father. That same map is also coveted by Lu Rongguang, who was Zhenyuan's business partner. Meanwhile, Chen Shuxian and Chen Shufen came to Singapore for career opportunities, but their mother, who came with the sisters, was murdered shortly after arrival. Through the subsequent investigation, Shuxian got to know police officer Lu Zhiwei, and Shufen began an intimate relationship with Zhenyuan's son, Alex Su. Shuxian, meanwhile, discovered that her mother's death may be linked to Zhenyuan, and later became embroiled on Rongguang's plot to get the treasure map.
title: The truth

overview: The discovery of murdered businessman Marco Pierboni sends shock waves through the small Italian town of Lucca.
title: Delitti Privati

overview: Whether volcanoes, tornadoes, or asteroids, natural disasters are a constant threat. Our only option: Take on the challenges of natural hazards with brilliant engineering. But do we really stand a chance against these constantly worsening forces of nature? Humans and nature compete against each other repeatedly using technology against the vicissitudes of nature. It's a vital, ongoing contest.
title: Die Macht der Natur

overview: Ayla, now a famous singer, faces threats from stalkers and business enemies, leading her to hire Tawan as her bodyguard. As they grow closer, childhood feelings resurface, and Ayla tries to win Tawan's heart with help from friends and Tawan's team. However, they oppose the relationship, setting the stage for a love story challenged by family and society. Can they navigate these obstacles and find their way back to each other?
title: Only you

overview: A murder-mystery set in Rancho Santa Fe, California, that follows the newly wealthy Parker family as they aim to position their teenage daughters in the rarified, sometimes deadly world of competitive horse racing.
title: Girls and Their Horses

overview: In the late 60s, Rita, Rachel, Muriel, and Stéphane formed a rock band called Tiger Lily. Two decades later, after long having put away their guitars, the women look back at their lives.
title: Tiger Lily, quatre femmes dans la vie

overview: The Beverley Allitt Tapes looks at how in 1993, a shy, unassuming young nurse went on to receive 13 life sentences for the murder, attempted murder and grievous bodily harm of a 13 children which took place during the space of 59 days whilst working on a ward at Grantham and Kesthevan Hospital, Lincolnshire in 1991, making her one of Britain's most notorious female killers. The gritty series re-examines her crimes and the impact they had on all those effected. From the investigators who brought her to justice, to the parent whose child had a very lucky escape encounter with Allitt, to the medical professionals seeking legitimate explanations for the inexplicable deaths, through to the impact on the families of the victims, as well as the survivors physically and mentally scarred by their experiences.
title: The Beverley Allitt Tapes

overview: The ultimate athletes and the ultimate filmmakers paired with Hollywood story telling: Pulitzer Prize-nominee and Hollywood screenwriter Stephen Schiff (Wall Street: Money Never Sleeps, Lolita, True Crime) teams up with the action-sports wizards from MSP and Red Bull Media House to ask the ultimate questions: Why do these athletes do what they do? Why do they risk everything to achieve something as fleeting as a ski line on a remote crag, a momentary descent down a waterfall few have ever seen, or a leap through space between man-made mounds created solely for a leap through space? Chris Davenport, Antoine Montant, Hervé Cerutti, Steve Fisher and other action sports legends join forces with cameramen greats like Scott Gaffney, Dustin Lindgren and Guillaume Tessier to explore the fine line between extreme sport, philosophy and art. Directed by Murray Wais and Steve Winter, this cinematic quest will take you from the Rocky Mountains to Morocco, from Bolivia to China, and from Thailand to Norway, as it gives rise to the most breathtaking stories. Narrated by three time Academy Award-nominee Nick Nolte.
title: Red Bull Ultimate Rush

overview: Young beauty Naami and young, successful Ezhdar. A love story, like a fairy tale. But is this magical fairy tale? What hides in the walls of the ancient castle? Can love to confront the world? Conspiracy, intrigue and outright hostility? So if love is strong as we think? Is this what mother's daughter wanted, our main character, falling in love with the lively and romantic guy?
title: Sen Benimsin

overview: The WWI is the focus of the tetralogy novel "Time of Death" by Dobrica Ćosić. It paints a broad picture of time, events, and human fates. Other than members of the Katić family, many historical individuals are among the primary heroes.
title: Vreme Smrti

overview: Discover the secrets of the Loire Valley châteaux through their history and heritage.
title: Les Châteaux de la Loire

overview: Powerless is set in the kingdom of Ilya where the Elites reign supreme with their breathtaking powers—and hunt those without. Paedyn Gray, a powerless Ordinary, has spent years scraping by as a thief in the slums, hiding in plain sight after the King had her father executed. But when she inadvertently saves the life of Prince Kai, the cruel King's second son and designated Ordinary hunter, she is thrust into the kingdom's prestigious Purging Trials — a savage competition promising glory, riches, and a spotlight she has fought her whole life to avoid. The fascinating yet lethal Prince is dead-set on winning the trials Paedyn can barely hope to survive – but soon the two realize that the biggest challenge they will have to face might just be withstanding the irresistible pull between them, a connection as profound as it is unthinkable…
title: Powerless

overview: Alin and Jane are childhood best friend. They grew up together, living next door to each other. Unbeknownst to Alin, Jane has been secretly harboring feelings for her for a long time. One day, Alin leaves Jane to study abroad. Years later, a broken engagement brings her home, where they face feelings long unspoken.
title: My Safe Zone

overview: When a famous influencer is found dead at her friend's wedding, a cynical cop has to turn over the darkest secrets to find the killer. Will friendship, loyalty, and family survive the interrogation?
title: Chhal Kapat - The Deception

overview: Most Wanted: Teen Hacker follows the illegal exploits of Finnish hacker Julius Kivimäki, known as Aleksanteri Kivimäki, who rose to infamy after forcing a U.S. passenger plane to make an emergency landing, shutting down PlayStation globally and orchestrating several dangerous SWAT attacks – including one targeting the family of an FBI agent.
title: Most Wanted: Teen Hacker
Wang Ye, Ni Jia Meng Fei Tai Xiao Zhang Le

overview: It tells a story about three strangers, polarized by profession and personality-collide through a string of ritualistic serial killings. Their investigation peels back layers of deception, exposing the Rosefinch's century-spanning conspiracy.
title: Rosefinch

overview: After escaping a brutal prison, 47 arrives in Wangcheng to track down the men who betrayed his father years ago. Along the way, he gets caught between old alliances, deadly pursuers, and an unexpected connection with a woman named Qi Jun.
title: The Awakening

overview: Lian Xinruo, the wealthy and happy daughter of a prosperous family, experiences a sudden catastrophe that robs her of everything. Her attempts at justice fail, and she is even buried alive, only to be rescued by Pei Yuze, the second master of the Pei family. Determined to uncover the truth and exact revenge, Lian Xinruo returns five years later under the alias of singer Du Youmeng. Together with Pei Yuze, she carefully orchestrates a brilliant and satisfying game of vengeance…
title: A Fleeting Dream

overview: Genius painter Lu Li infiltrates the Shilun Group to uncover the truth behind his parents' brutal murder, drawing close to the company's illegitimate daughter, Qin Yuebai. The two use and tempt each other, joining forces in a calculated partnership. Step by step, they uncover each other's secrets and true identities. From sparring to sincerity, from mutual exploitation to standing side by side through adversity, love gradually heals the imperfections in both their lives.
title: Double Fugue

overview: After a freak accident transmigrates Xiao Ning into the Great Jing Dynasty as the disgraced live-in son-in-law of the Su family, he revolutionizes the empire with forgotten arts, transforming tea into ambrosia and turning wine into liquid gold. As commoners clamor for his creations, he shatters conventions by founding the realm's first newspaper, rallying geniuses to empower a princess's political asce
title: Royal Upstart

overview: Hosted by Australian icon Ernie Dingo, ABC News Breakfast host Bridget Brennan and introducing Isaac Compton as their studio sidekick, it's set to be a big, blak night of entertainment. The showcase will feature a stellar line up of guests and First Nation stars including Steph Tisdell, Dane Simpson, Abbie Chatfield, Jimmy Barnes, Outback Tom, Barkaa, Kevin Kropinyeri and many more. Featuring performances of iconic black anthems from the award winning Aboriginal Australian music duo Electric Fields, Maningrida all-female rock band The Ripple Effect Band and ARIA-nominated singer, songwriter, rapper Miss Kaninna. It's loud, it's proud, it's a variety hour not to be missed.
title: That Blackfella Show

overview: Before hitting it big ashome renovation and real estate dynamos, Drew and Jonathan Scott spent their childhood on a horse ranch. Now the Brothers will use their background to help buyers with a hankering for adventure find their dream properties Follow the twin duo as they take families who wish to escape hectic city life or own land discover the incredible attributes and unique challenges of ranch living, including adapting to a slower pace, tending livestock and growing produce. The series will highlight cinematic landscapes with properties in Arizona, California and Texas and find Drew and Jonathan revisiting some ranch-inspired activities like horseback riding, off-roading in ATVs, and the art of lassoing. With the Brothers' help, each set of buyers will feel more prepared to live out their Wild West fantasy lives.
title: Chasing the West

overview: The television images from all channels, from "Zeit im Bild" to sports, from prime time shows to social media, are analyzed, reinterpreted and brought to the Maschek remix once a month. The television material in the (almost) lip-synced flashback of the two voice anarchos - real fake and cleverly stupid.
title: Maschek

overview: In a small peaceful desert town, residents mysteriously start spontaneously combusting. Mimi, a mine clearance company instructor, believes these cases are not caused by landmines, but by a phenomenon she experienced in her childhood – where a deep sense of loneliness ignites a deadly inner flame. Along with her childhood friend Dikla, a police officer in the local station, they investigate the spreading phenomenon trying to track down who is behind it and stop them from terrorizing the serene town.
title: Fireflies

overview: There's plenty of fun in the kitchen in this cookery series for young children.
title: Cegin Cyw

overview: 'Late Check Out', hosted by Ellie Taylor, will follow every episode of the main show on ITVX and as a podcast. Viewers and listeners will be taken on a deep dive into all things Fortune Hotel, with behind-the-scenes gossip, exclusive clips, and interviews with the hotel's freshly checked-out pairs and special guests along the way. 'Late Check Out' will also feature exclusive scenes with Stephen Mangan as he reacts to the dramatic Night Caps, plus there are two special episodes which feature hilarious outtakes from him. Additionally, the vodcast will also showcase ‘The Golden Case reveal', where eliminated pairs discover who was holding the money, with shocks and revelations aplenty. The Fortune Hotel: Late Check Out will go out across ITVX, YouTube & all Global platforms (including Spotify and Apple).
title: Late Check Out

overview: Join in all the fun with your friends in the CBeebies House. Find things to make and do, watch fun clips and sing along with songs and Number Raps.
title: CBeebies House: Time to Play

overview: Join Bella and Lift on a fun-filled adventure exploring the floors of Playtime Towers. Meet playful friends for singing, dancing, making and laughing. How will you play today?
title: Playtime Towers

overview: Jordan Gray stars as Liv, a transgender egomaniac, causing havoc in the strange world of the supermarket nightshift. Having been hired to work there by Pellocks boss Simon after he inadvertently offended the LGBTQ+ community with an ill-conceived marketing campaign, Liv soon realises she's unsackable and sets about turning the store into her own personal playground, unleashing chaos on everyone and everything around her.
title: Transaction

overview: Genres have existed nearly as long as music itself. Labeling. Categorizing. These are deeply human activities, rooted in behavioral evolution and survival, so it is no surprise that people have been instinctually compelled to do it to what they hear. There have been benefits: Labeling music has made it easier to talk about, and to sell. But dividing music has also divided people. And while it may be human nature to categorize, it is also human nature to combine, to merge, to collaborate, and adulterate. The times are changing: We exist in a moment where it's no longer incumbent upon you to choose a genre, to pick a side, to belong to just one culture. You are free to be you and to traverse lines that are blurred and borders that are broken, thanks to some radical ideas, and actors, who have changed the game. The only gatekeeper to you enjoying a style of music, is you. And REVOLT TV exists to reflect that vision, and feed that appetite. Since the launch of our network, we have spoken with artists of all walks about the past, present, and future of genres: Why they exist, who they have served, and where they're headed. And beginning this coming Monday, we are proud to bring this long-gestating project to you. On November 16th, REVOLT TV premieres a new series titled Breaking Genres. Over the course of five episodes this fall, we frame, foment, and stoke a conversation on the state of genre-based thinking in music, incorporating exclusive interviews with pioneers of the movements like Rick Rubin, Chuck D, Erykah Badu, Travis Barker, Nas, Common, The Clash's Mick Jones and Paul Simonen, super producers Ariel Rechtshaid and Diplo, Amber Coffman, Animal Collective's Avey Tare, and so many more, as we tackle the pivotal cultural moments, the social figures, and the technological and socio-political movements that have altered the course of what was once a stifled and strict space of aesthetic restriction, but is now a landscape where the old rules have been shattered, and new rules rule.
title: Breaking Genres

overview: Terry McMillan Presents is a banner for a series of original movies executive produced by the bestselling author Terry McMillan and produced by Lifetime. The movies, focus on the love and lives of African American women,
title: Terry McMillan Presents

overview: For a neighborhood as renowned for its spectacular holiday displays as Evergreen Lane, the street has long been modest when it comes to Halloween. But when fun and spooky new neighbors, Luna and Marvin move to the block, Emily, Jared and the rest of the HOA agree to get in on the seasonal fun and launch EverSCREAM Lane to fundraise for a local charity. As the block pulls together to plan creepy contests, spine-chilling décor and a spooktacular carnival, new haunted hijinks ensue with Pamela, Ned, Mary Louise and the rest of the block. Through the process, Emily rediscovers the joys of the holiday that she and her late grandmother once cherished.
title: Haul Out the Holly

overview: Ever wished you could go on holiday with the cast of Coronation Street, I'm A Celebrity…, The Chase or Loose Women? Well now you can, sort of… The Great Escapers is a brand-new prime time series, which will take some of the nation's best known ITV faces and send them off on their very first holiday together. We know they've worked alongside each other for many years, but can they now holiday together? Let's see as they pack their bags, jet off to the sunshine and check in to their hotel. The Great Escapers will show the celebrities as we've never seen them before. In each episode, three stars will compete to give their colleagues the best holiday experience they can. But will one star's dream day out prove to be another's worst nightmare? Jet2holidays will have a friendly overseas customer helper on hand throughout the experience to help guide each celebrity with their activity choices. Will the celeb choose what they personally like or try to guess what their travel companions would prefer? At the end of the trip, the three celebrities will vote for who put together the most memorable day and one of them will be crowned The Greatest Escaper.
title: The Great Escapers

overview: The ocean has its stars - dolphins, sharks, Manta rays, whales - and then there are the others, the humble and the discreet, which can only get the limelight thanks to a Disney movie. Yet, from the clown fish to the octopus, the lionfish to the cleaner fish, without of course omitting the coral, all these creatures are the essential characters of the riveting marine life theatre. With its playful narration and exceptional HD footage, Comme un poisson dans l'eau brings a new vision of this underwater universe. You will discover the secrets of its inhabitants through a profusion of colours, shapes and behaviours.
title: Comme un poisson dans l'eau

overview: The Book of Acts explosively reimagined in an alternate-modern era. A resurrection sparks a movement that turns the world upside down, spreading hope amid chaos. As the followers risk everything to preach the good news, the Temple races to silence them before the oppressive Imperium regime retaliates. But public miracles, unburied secrets, and fractured loyalties force both sides to confront the true cost of their choices.
title: Testament

overview: 2024 Danish version of the popular quiz show. Contestants are provided with the answers by the host, to which they would then have to supply the questions.
title: Jeopardy!

overview: 5 mal 5 was an German adaptation of the US game show Lingo. Two pairs played against each other in several rounds, where they had to guess a five-letter word in five attempts. If they failed, the letters contained in the word they were looking for were marked.
title: 5 mal 5

overview: Ms. X centres on a woman who teams up with an old high school friend to scare her cheating husband into staying faithful. However, when things turn (accidentally) homicidal, she becomes caught between the cops, the cartel, and a vicious PTA.
title: Ms. X

overview: In the aftermath of World War Two, the Allies sought to bring the aggressors to justice. How did the surviving Nazi leaders give account for their actions? Nuremberg: Nazis on Trial is a BBC documentary film series consisting of three one-hour films that re-enact the Nuremberg War Trials of Albert Speer, Hermann Göring and Rudolf Hess. They were broadcast on BBC Two in 2006 to coincide with the 60th anniversary of the trials.
title: Nuremberg: Nazis on Trial

overview: In 1941, Vera Treshnikova was the only doctor left in the city. Her hospital was under 24-hour surveillance by the Gestapo. In order to continue performing her medical duty, Vera pretended to collaborate with the fascists. The townspeople condemned her, but did not know that the girl was hiding a partisan movement center in the hospital.
title: Доктор Вера

overview: Undeniable with Joe Buck is a one‐on‐one interview show that gives legendary athletes and coaches the opportunity to share their ascent to the pinnacle of success through their personal life stories and philosophies. The adult and hour‐long conversation will be to the world of sports what shows like Dinner for Five and Inside the Actors Studio are to the world of Film and Television and Charlie Rose and Terri Gross are to the world of popular culture. Filmed in front of an audience and hosted by Joe Buck, Undeniable creates a genuine and honest conversation about who these legends are, how they approach things, what they've learned and what lies ahead. The show doesn't search for controversy, but rather seeks insight into true icons of the game and how they've succeeded so far above the rest.
title: Undeniable with Joe Buck
